verdict.rationale: The Division publishes a self-service online account layer, the Premier Business Services (PBS) account, with its own setup videos. Filings, standing certificates and records are available online without a counter visit, which suggests a remotely completable sign-in path. The evidence never describes how sign-in is secured: there is no mention of credential MFA, and nothing rules out mailed PINs or identity proofing. The text/push/email notices cover record changes and reminders, not authentication. Missing for 10: documented MFA method for PBS sign-in, explicit confirmation that no mailed PIN, in-person, or biometric step is required, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sign-in flow.
